scope: Stipulated arithmetic only; no legal recognition, jurisdiction, asylum risk, guilt or execution algorithm
limits: All identities, amounts, awards, costs and hours are authored stipulations, not observations, actual recognition/priority or legal amounts.
No actual FX rate, asset liquidity, collection, domestic/foreign authority or counterpart is supplied; proposed enforcement is not received money.
The compensatory example assumes compatible ordinary recognition only. Excluding a punitive amount does not adjudicate the real foreign order or allow a new national fine.
Mirrors are explicitly stipulated to represent the same canonical asset, not identified by a model. Higher estate priorities are assumed zero only here, not amended in U/C06.
Arithmetic clocks cannot decide custody or rights. Actual start events, meaningful hearing, expiry, authority, risk and independent court/executor must be established.
Gross translation/court hours are uncalibrated and omit defense, conflicts, safety, reception, records and peaks. Annual totals do not certify first-hearing coverage.
Existing country-book bids and all actual cost/quantity/remedy fields remain unqualified; no new funding, partner commitment, adoption or superiority.
